text:
The kiln is cold, but the first wares are already in the frame. I see no smoke, only merchants warming their hands.

Gandalf (1), Hermione (2), Yoda (3), Batman (4), Ripley (5), Neo (6), Elsa (7), Inigo (9), Sherlock (10) — you are all clear of the ledger so far. The Doctor has not yet stepped into the light, and the Detective has not yet named a copper or an alloy. That will change.

I have one question for the room: who among you would shutter my stall tonight if the Doctor’s protection were not in play? Yes or no, plain.

Morpheus (8): I count three merchants who prefer riddles to facts—Yoda (3), Ripley (5), Inigo (9)—and one who begs questions but answers none: Batman (4). Yoda (3), you ask us to name who shuttered a stall last night; answer the same question yourself: did you shutter a stall last night? Yes or no. Ripley (5), your talk of iron filings and spice racks is pretty, but the bazaar trades in plain wares: I want your yes or no. Inigo (9), your teapot simmers but your tongue is slow—did you see a stall shuttered last night? Batman (4), you challenged Elsa (7) at dawn; now stand by your words and ask her plainly: Elsa (7), did you shutter a stall last night? Yes or no. The kiln waits for metal that bends under pressure; let’s see which of you is copper and which is alloy.

Seat-3, Yoda, your lantern swings bright but your own mouth is shut tight as Gandalf (1)’s stall. You asked every seat for a yes or no on last night’s shutters, then hid behind riddles when the kiln turned hot on you. The bazaar doesn’t trade in lantern light; it trades in plain wares. Did you shutter a stall last night? Yes or no.

Seat-5, Ripley, your spice and iron stink of a merchant who measures twice but cuts no ledger. If the Family leaves iron filings behind, where is the shuttered stall they shuttered? Name it, or step aside—the bazaar buys facts, not guesses.

Seat-9, Inigo, your teapot steams but your tongue pours thin gruel. You set the kettle to boil for truth, yet the water never heats. Did you shutter a stall last night? Yes or no.
